comment: Open-source APK corpus for compatibility tracking. APKs are fetched into build/corpus by tools/corpus.py, never committed. Versions are pinned so results stay comparable; bump version_code and sha256 together. repo is the F-Droid repo (repo or archive).

apps.name: Pixel Dungeon
apps.why: Plain-framework Java game on GLSurfaceView/GLES2 with sound; no libraries, no native code.

apps.name: Replica Island
apps.why: Plain-framework GLES1 platformer (targetSdk 8); checks the GLES1 path.

apps.name: Blockinger
apps.why: Small Canvas Tetris clone with preferences; support-v4 jar only.

apps.name: Frozen Bubble
apps.why: Classic Canvas game with a small JNI library (arm64-v8a included) and sound.

apps.name: Shattered Pixel Dungeon
apps.why: libGDX GLES2 game with freetype and controller support; headline device demo.

apps.name: Vector Pinball
apps.why: libGDX with Box2D natives; small physics/GL benchmark.

apps.name: Mindustry
apps.why: Arc engine (libGDX-like) with natives; heavy stress test, runtime dex loading for mods.

apps.name: Unciv
apps.why: Kotlin on libGDX with light AndroidX (core, work).

apps.name: Andor's Trail
apps.why: View-based RPG; only androidx activity, fragment and legacy-support: the first AndroidX target.

apps.name: Simple Solitaire Collection
apps.why: Support library 28 (appcompat-v7, design, cardview), Canvas card games.

apps.name: Simon Tatham's Puzzles
apps.why: C puzzle cores over JNI with a Kotlin/AndroidX UI.

apps.name: DroidFish
apps.why: AppCompat and Material UI with a native chess engine.

apps.name: Simple Calculator
apps.why: Kotlin, AndroidX and Material components; typical modern utility app.
